clips.send: “Renaissance” (文艺复兴) means “rebirth”: scholars revived Greek and Roman learning — but used it to celebrate human talent and life in this world. That idea is called humanism (人文主义). Memory hook“1450 the press, 1517 the protest, 1555 the split.”
clips.text: “Renaissance” (文艺复兴) means “rebirth”: scholars revived Greek and Roman learning — but used it to celebrate human talent and life in this world. That idea is called humanism (人文主义). 🎵 Memory hook“1450 the press, 1517 the protest, 1555 the split.”

clips.send: “文艺复兴”的原意是“再生”：学者们复兴古希腊罗马的学问，用它来赞美人的才能和现世生活。这种思想叫作人文主义。 记忆口诀“1450印刷机，1517论纲起，1555欧洲分。”
